metadata.description: Loomground system — the editorial pipeline (hub tree), its course/lecture orchestrator, and the Versum knowledge-graph plugin (the one write path + a mental-model organiser).

plugins.name: loomground-editorial
plugins.description: An editorial system as one plugin — a tree of coordinator hubs, not a sequence. A root orchestrator routes by mode to hubs (ingest, scan, research, verification, argument-hardening, render, capture-to-kg) and enforces three gates. Each run yields talking points with a Sources list, saved to the conf

plugins.name: loomground-course-orchestrator
plugins.description: Course/lecture hub — projects approved editorial talking points and KG-verified claims into micro-learning lessons and assembled courses. Read-only on the configured knowledge graph; grounds lecture order in the concept graph and proposes candidate concepts for curation. Five modes (foundation, less

plugins.name: loomground-versum
plugins.description: The Loomground Versum knowledge-graph plugin: the one write path into the graph and an organiser that places documents by the mental models they share with the corpus. loomground-knowledge-write admits a source (identity, dedup, sidecar, index); loomground-organise ranks concept-neighbour domains, a person confirms, then hands off to the write path. Configurable effort (deterministic / local-first / cloud); never auto-files.

plugins.name: solver-addons
plugins.description: Provider-neutral deterministic advice for deciding when optional Loomground Solver world-model and metacognition add-ons are useful. It reports scores, requirements, missing inputs, benefits and risks; it never retrieves data, selects providers, activates modules or authorizes actions.
